# hg envfile

**What this page tells you:** every `hg envfile` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

Profile environment files: list, use, set, unset (values never print).

## Synopsis

```text
hg envfile list [flags]
hg envfile use <path/.env>
hg envfile set K=V [K=V ...] [flags]
hg envfile unset K [K ...] [flags]
```

## `hg envfile list`

```text
hg envfile list [flags]
```

Sources + names (values never print).

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--profile` | `<name>` | — | Narrow to one profile; default is every onboarded profile. |

## `hg envfile use`

```text
hg envfile use <path/.env>
```

Pin the env file for every profile.

## `hg envfile set`

```text
hg envfile set K=V [K=V ...] [flags]
```

Set variables.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--profile` | `<name>` | — | Narrow to one profile; default is every onboarded profile. |
| `--restart` | — | — | Restart the profile so the change takes effect now. |

## `hg envfile unset`

```text
hg envfile unset K [K ...] [flags]
```

Remove variables.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--profile` | `<name>` | — | Narrow to one profile; default is every onboarded profile. |
| `--restart` | — | — | Restart the profile so the change takes effect now. |
